homepage.title: Slot
homepage.description: This module allows you to manage slots and reservations on your site.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: Manage your slots. Click on a slot to edit or delete it. Click on the calendar to create a new slot.

CreateSlots.title: Create a slot
CreateSlots.description: Set the day and time for your new slot.
CreateSlots.startDateInThePast: The selected date is in the past.

EditSlot.title: Edit slot
EditSlot.description: Modify the time and capacity of this slot.
EditSlot.deleteDescription: Choose how to delete this slot.
EditSlot.deleteAllSameHour: Delete all slots at this hour

token.title: Your access key
token.description: Your access keys allow you to access the Basalf SLOT API. These keys must be kept secret and never shared. If you lose these keys, you will no longer be able to access the Basalf SLOT API. If you share them, you could expose your account to security risks. If you lose them, contact us immediately.
